description: MUTATES Accelo data: creates a new contact (a person). Accelo API: POST /api/v0/contacts (form-encoded). NOTE: a contact's company affiliation is set separately via an affiliation (POST /api/v0/contacts/{id}/affiliations), not on creation. Returns { meta, response } with the created contact.
